display_long_description:
Detect the Threat. Protect the Border.
Step into the role of a border security officer at a high-risk checkpoint where every traveler could be hiding something.
Use advanced scanning tools, inspect documents, and make critical decisions under pressure.
A single mistake could let danger through.
🔍 Scan & Detect Hidden Threats
Use a high-tech threat scanner to reveal concealed items, suspicious anomalies, and high-risk individuals.
Not everything is visible—you must detect what others miss.
🛂 Inspect Documents Under Pressure
Verify passports, identities, and permits.
Catch forged documents, mismatched details, and suspicious behavior before it’s too late.
🚗 Search Vehicles & Contraband
Inspect vehicles, cargo, and compartments.
Uncover hidden weapons, illegal items, and smuggled goods trying to cross the border.
🧍 Identify Suspicious Travelers
Observe behavior, scan for anomalies, and detect threats in real time.
Some travelers look normal… but aren’t.
🩺 Detect Infection & Risk
Use medical scanners to identify abnormal vitals, contamination, and hidden conditions.
Quarantine threats—or risk letting them pass.
⚖️ Make High-Stakes Decisions
Approve, deny, detain, or quarantine.
Every choice impacts border security, public safety, and your performance.
🎮 Built for VR Immersion
•	Realistic scanning tools 
•	Interactive inspection gameplay 
•	Designed for Meta Quest 
•	Smooth controls with comfort options 
•	Seated & standing play modes 
🚨 Can You Stop the Threat in Time?
